newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian cen. bank sells 356 bln rbls bills, bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russian cen. bank sells 356 bln rbls bills, bonds.

text.p: The central bank sold 356.35 billion roubles ($61.7 million) nominal of GKO discount Treasury bills and OFZ interest-bearing government bonds on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Friday, the open-market operations
The bank made the following transactions:

The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 21076 issue closed on Friday at 85.06 percent, the 21078 issue closed at 93.71 percent, the 22081 issue closed at 89.05 percent, the 22085 issue closed at 88.43 percent, 23007 issue closed at 86.25 percent and the 25001 issue closed at 102.87 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the central bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
